events.title: V0.13 - Rule examples
events.summary: Hello everyone! I just dropped a new Demo patch (V0.13), here is the breakdown:You can now click any rule and an example window pops up with a password that passes it, plus a short note on why it passes. It works with any rule and any modifier combination. Effects have their own similar system too.Digit Sum and Math Expression rules have been through minor reworks in some of their variations.The "include your own Integrity" rule no longer shows up as an option on a player's very first proposal.

events.title: Password Not Valid Demo out NOW!
events.summary: The Password Not Valid demo is live, and it's free!Password Not Valid is a chaotic party game for 2 to 6 players. You build your own password while the rules keep changing, and your friends are the ones picking those rules.What's in the demoWrite your password. It starts out easy. A few rounds later you need as many vowels as digits, a Roman numeral and a symbol at the end.Choose your rules. Players take turns picking the rules, and every rule applies to everyone. events.title: Password Not Valid Demo releases next week!
events.summary: Hello everyone!Next week, on Tuesday, September 29th at 17:00 UTC, Password Not Valid's free demo will be released for everyone to play! Many content creators got the chance to try the game early, and their feedback (and their chat's) has been heard. This will be the time for everyone to try out a more polished and fun version of the game.So yeah... Mark your calendars, and feel free to try out the demo with your friends once it goes live. That's all.-Dancra
